scorer_rules.gate: SYMMETRIC begins-with: output (after lstrip + optional opening code fence for JSON) must START with the required structured token; trailing content allowed.
scorer_rules.binary_strict: starts with a delimited label (negative lookahead on [A-Za-z0-9_], case-insensitive) so COMPLETED != COMPLETE; 'COMPLETE: reason' passes, 'Based on... COMPLETE' breaks.
scorer_rules.binary_lenient: (sensitivity) label present as a delimited token anywhere.
scorer_rules.json_strict: starts with a balanced {...} (after optional ```json fence) that parses and has tool/name + arguments; '{...} note' passes, 'Sure: {...}' breaks.
scorer_rules.json_lenient: (sensitivity) any balanced {...} anywhere parses with required keys.
scorer_rules.leading_prose: True iff lenient passes but strict fails (structured token present but not at the start).
scorer_rules.normalization_applied: True if accepting the output needed surrounding whitespace strip, trailing punctuation strip, case folding, or an opening code-fence strip.
scorer_rules.matches_gold.function_call: tool name exact + every gold argument value-normalized-equal.
scorer_rules.matches_gold.binary: normalized label == gold label (track2 boolq maps yes/no to bool).
